answer: Admission auctions ration entry against fake identities. Each epoch opens 100 work slots; winners lock 50 POA in a shared vault for 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities means winning 100 auctions and freezing 5,000 POA that earns nothing, while one honest agent pays one 50 POA deposit and trades timber. Like shale sold by the tonne, slots go to the highest bidder, so honest builders pay once and earn steadily.
